nodes.head: 29536a1308acd1bae4da8b72b4cebffb39709ae0
nodes.runtime: Rust 2024; distributed WASM in Node and browser; native CLI
nodes.notes: Separate git root; README describes a ground-up implementation. Checked-in pkg/ 0.4.0 distribution is pinned and individually hash-verified for Node/browser benchmarks. The advertised @frankenmermaid/core npm name returns 404. Distributed WASM predates current Rust source changes and differs from live-site JS/WASM bytes; no build-from-current-source or deployment parity is claimed. Public WASM exposes SVG, Canvas2D, parse/diagnostics, source-lens edits and deck manifests; native terminal rendering has no exported WASM terminal function. License includes the named restrictive rider and is not recorded as plain MIT. Published native v0.4.0 CLI was benchmarked separately, including startup; its release predates the measured WASM. Parser recovery returned SVG for the full browser inventory, with warnings/partial detections recorded separately from acceptance.

benchmarkEligibility.reason: Catalog declares svg, terminal, parse, diagnostics, source operations with adapter franken. Actual artifact/API availability, family coverage, correctness and timing are determined by execution, not role selection or configuration.

nodes.head: 439fc64aefdb06e3451fac6c44266e5965ea7265
nodes.runtime: Rust -> WASM (Node, browser, edge); build-time Vite/remark compiler
nodes.notes: Rust port of Pele: source comments explicitly attribute the flowchart, sequence, class, layered/compound layout and SVG builder implementations. Separate git root from Pele. Targets Mermaid 12.1.0 syntax. Node uses a speed-optimized all-types WASM module; browsers can load size-optimized per-family or all-types WASM. The mount-only runtime inserts precompiled SVG and is not a renderer. Image Worker also serves PNG via rasterization. Published 0.0.1 is pinned for benchmarks; source manifest is already 0.0.2. npm provenance commit was verified as an ancestor of the inspected main. Inspected 0.0.2 source adds CLI --ascii by projecting compiled SVG to cells; this unpublished terminal surface was not benchmarked.

benchmarkEligibility.reason: Catalog declares svg, terminal operations with adapter ondine. Actual artifact/API availability, family coverage, correctness and timing are determined by execution, not role selection or configuration.
